content.text: On the login form, submitting with Enter while the first /auth/login request is still in flight sends a second identical POST. Both can succeed and create two session rows, or the second fails with 409 and surfaces a misleading error over the successful login.

While a login attempt is pending, further submits (button or Enter) must be ignored. The button disables on click but the form onSubmit still accepts Enter because disabled is only on the button, not a submitting flag on the form.
Duplicate sessions confuse session management and rate limits. A isSubmitting guard at the form level before calling the auth client fixes the double POST.
